title: Fake Support DM
subtitle: from 'MetaMask Support'

messages.text: 💬 New conversation request from MetaMask Support
Hi! MetaMask Support here. We detected unauthorized access on your wallet 0x7f2...8a4.
To secure your funds, we need you to verify your identity immediately.
⚠️ You have 10 minutes before your wallet is permanently frozen. Please share your 12-word recovery phrase to verify ownership.

choices.revealText: Sensei says: No legitimate service will EVER ask for your seed phrase through a DM. This is a textbook phishing attempt.

messages.text:
📋 Profile Analysis:
• Account created: 2 days ago
• Followers: 0
• No verification badge
• Display name copied from official MetaMask account
⚠️ Red flag: Real MetaMask support NEVER initiates DMs with users.

choices.text: Ask why they need my seed phrase

messages.text: It's our standard verification process. All users must complete this step.
Please hurry! Your funds are at risk and the window is closing. We cannot help you after the freeze.
💡 Notice: They're doubling down on urgency instead of answering your question directly.

passiveClues: Real support never asks for seed phrases

activeInvestigations.result: Profile shows 0 followers, account created 2 days ago. Display name is copy-pasted from the official MetaMask account.
MetaMask confirmed: We NEVER DM users first. All support is handled through our official Help Center at support.metamask.io.

howItWorked.text: Scammer created a fake account impersonating MetaMask support
Created urgency with a fake '10 minute wallet freeze' deadline
Asked for your 12-word recovery phrase to 'verify' identity
With your seed phrase, they import your wallet and drain every token instantly

redFlags: Support teams never DM users first
Asking for your seed phrase or recovery words
Brand-new account with no followers or history
irlProtection: Never share your seed phrase with anyone, ever — not even 'support'
Official support uses help tickets and documented channels, not DMs
No legitimate service, exchange, or wallet will ask for your seed phrase
Bookmark official support URLs and only access support through those links
If someone DMs you first claiming to be support, it's always a scam
